rubric.role_summary: Machine learning research scientist working on medical NLP, including clinical conversation summarization, evaluation, and production deployment of research methods.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Machine learning research scientist working on medical NLP, including clinical conversation summarization, evaluation, and production deployment of research methods.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience in machine learning and natural language processing.
- Research background and an MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Sciences, or Mathematics, or equivalent experience.
- Programming experience crafting, prototyping, and delivering machine learning solutions into production.
- Experience with deep learning libraries and platforms.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Open-source contributions and deployed technology demonstrating real-world impact.
- Experience with deep learning libraries and platforms, multi-GPU training, and statistical analyses of observational and experimental data; the named libraries are examples, not an all-libraries requirement.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas. Relocation is offered; candidates outside these areas may qualify with explicit evidence of willingness to relocate. Current residence in the area is not mandatory. Explicit work-attendance terms (city labels use the area interpretation above): Must be willing to work from our SF office at least 3x per week This position requires a commitment to a hybrid work model, with the expectation of coming into the office a minimum of (3) three times per week. Relocation assistance is available for candidates willing to move to San Francisco.
